Brandon Miller.note: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

Kon Knueppel.note: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Dennis Schroder.note: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Dereck Lively II.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

Tarik Biberovic.note: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

Sergio de Larrea.note: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

Morez Johnson Jr..note: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

Ugonna Onyenso.note: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

Isaiah Joe.note: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

Jalen Duren.note: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

Anthony Edwards.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Donte DiVincenzo.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

LeBron James.note: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

Dominick Barlow.note: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Adem Bona.note: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Joel Embiid.note: Embiid (foot) remains questionable for Thursday's game against the Raptors, but he participated in the team's morning shootaround, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Ariel Hukporti.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Mark Williams.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Trayce Jackson-Davis.note: Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.

Scottie Barnes.note: Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

Kawhi Leonard.note: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

Nate Bittle.note: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

Tristan Vukcevic.note: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

Reece Beekman.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Justin Champagnie.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
